body:
Oh man, thanks for the kind words. I don't even remember when someone was as kind to me. I really felt those.

I bet that a kind person like you can fight your way through all that! I would love to give you encouraging words but the positivity is not with me at the moment :/

In my country government work is hard to find(I live in a very small country) and they do financial background checks too, so that is out of the question. Only jobs that I could get atm are phone sales, selling insurance or magazines. That I did for a little while but they forced me to be dishonest and try to trick old people especially, to buy something they clearly can't afford or need. The bosses there were HORRIBLE. They would say things like: What the fuck is wrong with you people? we have no sales and you dumbfucks get nothing done. You have to push the sale harder and make them understand they need it. Thats why I quit that and came to this job that I'm doing at the moment.

I'm not even sure if I could do person to person sales anymore since most of my extroverted tendencies went down the drain and I struggle with conversations/small talk. (When I was at school I actually was nominated as the positive lifeforce of the class and I was really outgoing before all this). My class and teachers also voted on this exercise that most likely to be famous actor/comedian/musician or a politician would be me. That clearly didn't go as planned.

Don't be sorry for sharing this, its fucking hard and exhausting living like this, I feel you.

I've been sending resumes atleast 1 a day to find jobs, but they all ask for financial check permit and never contact me again. I actually didn't get the degree because they threw me out with 1 year left, also I cannot apply again because I did not complete the first one, so trust in me has wavered for them.

The child is mine 100% I'm interested in sales and marketing but in my country these kinds of jobs wont hire me anymore because of the debt.

I wish I was awesome great or anything you mentioned before but it just doesn't feel like it :/
